scope: Post-exposure development diagnostic on all 32 frozen public forecast candidates; not independent confirmation or preregistration
information: Exact category masses from all category metadata; neither full forecast ranks nor outcomes used for masses; original fitting/validation/evaluation indices unchanged
split: First 4096 validation pairs supply X residual comparisons, last 4096 supply Y; no split selection
delta: Unchanged family_validation_delta(8); every method separately evaluated at same delta; no p-value minimum across methods
missing_category: Deterministic maximal residual product for categories absent from either stream
outputs: All 32 candidates, all component radii, original and revised p-values and full-family BY. Any post-exposure retained model is development evidence only.
